answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one vine weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The sonnet report publishes the merge explicitly at each sparrow. Because of that, anyone who spins up 282 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 41 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4140 identities would post 1664 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
